python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("src/types/checker/builtin_spl_classes/filesystem.rs")
s = p.read_text()
old = '''        property_assign_stmt(this_expr(), "iterStarted", bool_expr(false)),'''
new = '''        property_assign_stmt(this_expr(), "iterStarted", bool_expr(false)),
        // `seekState` was read by `current()` and `valid()` but only WRITTEN by `rewind()` and
        // `seek()`, so `(new SplFileObject($p))->current()` — php's own first-line idiom, with no
        // rewind — died on an uninitialized typed property.
        property_assign_stmt(this_expr(), "seekState", int_expr(0)),'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
print("seekState initialised too")
PY
